item.title: What Young Workers Are Doing to AI-Proof Themselves
Palantir extends reach into British state as gets access to sensitive FCA data
item.description:
📝 Palantir, co-founded by the billionaire Donald Trump donor Peter Thiel (pictured), has been appointed for a three-month trial period. The Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) has awarded Palantir a contract to investigate the watchdog’s internal intelligence data in an effort to help it tackle financial crime, which includes investigating fraud, money laundering and insider trading. Palantir will have to destroy data after completion of the contract and any intellectual property derived from the data trawling should be retained by the FCA.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/mar/22/palantir-extends-reach-into-british-state-as-it-gets-access-to-sensitive-fca-data
